style: Original opening comic; user-supplied fairy and dolphin character identities

prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. This is a strict continuation of the supplied GAME OPENING COMIC, not a new art direction. Reference images 1-4 are the exact visual style and protagonist model sheets. Reproduce their drawing language precisely: simply drawn flat characters over a bright tropical seaside backdrop, slightly rough warm dark-brown hand-drawn contours, broad FLAT color fills, tiny dot or short rectangular eyes, very simple small mouth, little or no facial shading, short unrendered gray-black hair in a plain silhouette, plain light-gray shirt and charcoal pants. Human protagonist is the VERY SIMPLE tiny boy from reference 1/2/3, NOT an elaborate handsome anime chef: NO chef coat, NO apron, NO detailed hair, NO glossy eyes or shaded face. Main otter must use the EXACT opening design: pale brown fur, flat cream muzzle and belly, scalloped cheek edges, SINGLE large central forehead tuft, narrow straight sleepy brown eyes, blush ovals. Do not redesign or embellish characters. Detailed background is subordinate and matches the opening's cyan halftone ocean/sky, sand, wooden boardwalk, thin palm leaves and very simple wooden stall with red fabric awning. NO enclosed elaborate restaurant, no hanging kitchen props, no painterly golden lighting, no glossy polished modern mobile-game rendering. Character interiors stay flat. Reference fidelity is more important than prettiness.
Output ONE 1536x1024 landscape PNG sprite atlas in a mathematically regular 3-column x 2-row grid of SIX square panels (512x512 each), zero margins and zero gutters, just thin dark rectangular borders. No lettering, no captions, no speech balloons; game adds text separately. Keep the SAME character model across all panels. Top row panels 1/2/3 = first meeting. Bottom row 4/5/6 = friendship completion. Medium/wide simple staging like the opening; do not fill every frame with enormous faces. Reference image 5 is the EXACT fairy identity, not an optional suggestion. Preserve her short GOLDEN BLONDE bob and long central bangs, large pointed ears, solid GREEN oval eyes under straight dark upper lids, simple cat-shaped mouth, pink cheek patches, strapless LIGHT GRAY dress with darker gray piping and belt, bare feet, PALE BLUE translucent wings. She has NO green hair, NO green dress, NO leaf accessories, NO flower hair clip. Keep her simple toy-like chibi proportions, outlined with brown textured linework like the opening. Fairy is roughly otter-sized, can hover just above deck.
1: At night, blonde fairy floats up to the simple red-awning seaside stall and taps a wood post, brown otter notices.
2: Fairy greets otter enthusiastically beside the stall; otter turns his head away in his exact sleepy-eyed original expression.
3: Fairy points eagerly at a simple dinner plate offered by the plain gray-shirt boy; otter stands nearby shyly.
4: Fairy contentedly finishes her meal with an empty plate at a simple outdoor table.
5: Fairy shows a small basket of forest fruit and mushrooms, boy and otter listen.
6: Boy gestures toward faraway forest trees at dusk, fairy glances at otter nervously, otter turns away. No wood gift yet.

Dolphin is a PLUMP ROUND PALE PERIWINKLE BLUE mascot with an oversized round head, very short muzzle (NO elongated bottlenose snout), tiny black dot nose, simple cat-shaped smile, heavy dark horizontal upper eyelids, black-to-lavender oval eyes, pink blush, WHITE muzzle patch continuous with large oval white belly, two tiny flippers, small dorsal fin, and split fluke tail. 1: Rounded periwinkle dolphin arrives at the simple red-awning seaside stall, sleepy critical eyes.
2: Dolphin surveys the table; brown otter leans toward the plain gray-shirt boy as if quietly warning him.
3: Boy with tiny dot eyes carefully plates a simple seafood dish, otter watches.
4: Round dolphin tastes food at the outdoor wooden table, looks quietly impressed.
5: Underwater, round dolphin points a tiny flipper at a rusty engine inside a sunken wooden wreck, tiny boat carrying boy and otter visible above.
6: Boy and otter look down at the rusty broken engine on the dock; ROUND short-snouted periwinkle dolphin watches from the water. Keep the exact mascot model even underwater. Engine is broken.

2: Engineer confronts main otter; main otter looks down apologetically. Simple expressive silhouettes.
3: Gray-shirt boy sets a steaming bowl between the two quiet otters at a simple outdoor table.
